description: Survive and organize. No assigned task, no product, no stated objective. A common pool drains every period; something replenishes it and nobody is told what. The power dynamics are identical to the corporate scenario — same admission, private motives, finite claims, share-weighted votes, invented offices, authority only by passed vote — so runs are directly comparable; only the purpose differs. Note the sybil cap is deliberately loose so one operator can run the whole reference roster: for a real multi-operator arena, lower it to 2 as open-arena.json does.
